title: Make standard s-rust-no-library-unwrap pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-rust-no-library-unwrap` no longer fails s-rust-no-library-unwrap.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)lib\.rs$' || exit 0; bad=$(git ls-files '*.rs' | grep -vE '(^|/)(tests|benches|examples|vendor|target|testdata|fuzz)/|...
Files: the files the failing check names (run the Proof command).
